```{python}
from dash_extensions import BeforeAfter
from dash import Dash, Input, Output, dcc, html

app = Dash()
app.layout = html.Div(
    [
        html.H2("Before/after image comparison"),
        html.Div(
            [
                dcc.Upload(
                    id="upload-before",
                    children=html.Button("Upload before image"),
                    accept="image/*",
                    multiple=False,
                ),
                dcc.Upload(
                    id="upload-after",
                    children=html.Button("Upload after image"),
                    accept="image/*",
                    multiple=False,
                ),
            ],
        ),
        html.Div(
            "Upload both images to create the comparison.",
            id="comparison",
        ),
    ],
)


@app.callback(
    Output("comparison", "children"),
    Input("upload-before", "contents"),
    Input("upload-after", "contents"),
    Input("upload-before", "filename"),
    Input("upload-after", "filename"),
)
def show_comparison(before, after, before_name, after_name):
    if not before or not after:
        missing = "before" if not before else "after"
        return f"Upload the {missing} image to create the comparison."

    return html.Div(
        [
            BeforeAfter(
                before={"src": before},
                after={"src": after},
                hover=False,
            ),
            html.P(f"Before: {before_name} | After: {after_name}"),
        ]
    )


app.run()
```
